
ADD-SCENARIO
Add a new scenario to an existing feature file

USAGE
  fspec add-scenario <file> <scenario-name>

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path (e.g., spec/features/login.feature)
  <scenario-name> (required)
    Name of the scenario (e.g., "Login with invalid password")

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Add new scenario
  $ fspec add-scenario spec/features/login.feature "Login with invalid password"
  ✓ Added scenario "Login with invalid password" to spec/features/login.feature

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-step
  fspec create-feature
  fspec delete-scenario

NOTES
  • Creates scenario with placeholder Given/When/Then steps
  • Scenario is added at the end of the feature file
